name: あかね的日本語教室
description:
Welcome to Akane’s Japanese class!!
Hello, my name's Akane and I'm a Japanese teacher.
My videos are meant for intermediate and advanced learners but if you're a beginner, that's perfectly OK!
Because all my content is in Japanese, you'll get used to the language faster and improve your listening skills.

name: KanamatopeJapanese
description:
This channel is designed for Japanese beginners.
It focuses on real-life scenario practice — shadowing and role-play scripts for places like restaurants, hotels, and convenience stores — plus longer phrase-listening drills organized by situation.

name: Speak Japanese Naturally
description:
This channel is designed for Japanese beginners.
You can learn through walk-and-talk videos where you listen to explanations in Japanese while enjoying views of Japanese scenery, as well as tips on how to study Japanese.
